name: Premium Dealership
locationDescription: The in-game location could not be verified from an accessible source.
description: CDID's largest showroom by stock. It sells luxury, exotic and imported models from many brands, most of them locked behind the Luxury or Rare Imports game passes.

name: Sumber Jaya Used Cars
locationDescription: The wiki lists the Sumber Jaya used-car dealership in Bekasi, and a 'Sumberjaya Bandung' branch in Bandung. Both are on the Jawa Barat map.
description: Second-hand Indonesian favourites from every era, from early Kijangs and Civics to modern MPVs.

name: Retro Cars Dealership
locationDescription: The in-game location could not be verified from an accessible source.
description: Cars of the past, from 1970s hot hatches to late-2000s saloons. Most models need the Retro Car Gamepass.

name: Otnas Esprit Works Cafe
locationDescription: The wiki lists 'Otnas Espirit Works' among Bandung's dealerships on the Jawa Barat map. Bandung was rebuilt as a standalone map in V2.7, so this placement may have changed.
description: A café-style showroom for enthusiast metal: JDM icons, European classics, tuned specials and rare imports.

name: Tokoma Dealership
locationDescription: The wiki lists Tokoma among the brand dealerships lining Jakarta's streets. The Tokoma Factory, a separate building, is in Bekasi.
description: The house of Indonesia's best-selling nameplates: Avanza, Kijang Innova, Fortuner, Alphard and more.

name: Liaxe Dealership
locationDescription: Listed on the wiki among Jakarta's brand dealerships.
description: Liaxe luxury saloons and SUVs.

name: Mestibis Dealership
locationDescription: Listed on the wiki among Jakarta's brand dealerships.
description: Mestibis family cars, SUVs and pickups.

name: Buffermacht Dealership
locationDescription: The wiki's Jakarta section lists a 'BMR/BMW' dealership; BMR was the earlier in-game name for the brand now called Buffermacht. Most BMR-badged cars are now marked removed in the community database.
description: German performance and luxury cars. Only a few Buffermacht models are currently on sale here; many have moved to the Premium Dealership.

name: Murceso-Venz Dealership
locationDescription: Listed on the wiki among Jakarta's brand dealerships.
description: Three-pointed-star luxury, from executive saloons to G-class off-roaders.

name: Hyunson Dealership
locationDescription: The wiki lists Hyunson dealerships in both Jakarta and Bekasi.
description: Korean hatchbacks, SUVs, MPVs and EVs.

name: Wuliuz Dealership
locationDescription: Listed on the wiki among Jakarta's brand dealerships.
description: Wuliuz MPVs and compact EVs.

name: Komercial Dealership
locationDescription: The wiki lists a commercial-vehicle dealership in Bekasi on the Jawa Barat map.
description: Trucks, buses, vans and light-commercial pickups for CDID's working drivers.

name: CIA Dealership
locationDescription: The wiki lists a CIA dealership in Bekasi on the Jawa Barat map.
